The family of Abigail Lizette Flores, a 16-year-old from Laredo, has turned to the community — with a GoFundMe and a plate sale, according to the Laredo Morning Times — to help cover funeral costs after she died following a stabbing in Zapata County.

Flores died Monday, October 26, after being stabbed Sunday in Zapata County, according to reports from the Zapata County Sheriff's Office summarized by the Times and other outlets. Deputies were sent to the 2400 block of Carla Street in Zapata around 8:18 p.m. Sunday and found Flores with life-threatening injuries. Her condition was first reported as critical but stable; she died Monday.

Francisco Javier Torres Jr., 20, was taken into custody right after the stabbing, the sheriff's office said. Her mother and aunt identified Torres as her boyfriend, according to the Times. He was first charged with aggravated assault of a family or household member with a weapon, causing serious bodily injury, a first-degree felony, and the charge was raised to murder after Flores died, the sheriff's office said. Texas Rangers with the state Department of Public Safety are helping investigate, and no motive has been released. Torres is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

Visitation will be held Monday, November 2, from 5 to 9 p.m. at Gamez & Sons Funeral and Cremation Services, with a prayer service at 7 p.m., according to her obituary. Visitation continues Tuesday, November 3, from 7 to 10:30 a.m., with a chapel service at 9:30 a.m.; the funeral procession departs at 10:30 a.m. for Laredo City Cemetery, where a graveside service will be held at 11:20 a.m. Arrangements are under the direction of Gamez & Sons, at 1029 Bob Bullock Loop in Laredo.

Webb Watch is sharing this story because the family's appeal is a community one: neighbors helping a grieving family meet funeral costs after a teenager's death. Details of the GoFundMe and plate sale are in the Laredo Morning Times report linked below.

Sources:

  • Laredo Morning Times, “GoFundMe, plate sale launched to help fund funeral for Laredo teen killed in Zapata,” October 28, 2026
  • Gamez & Sons Funeral and Cremation Services, obituary for Abigail Lizette Flores
